verdict.rationale: INPI runs an IP open-data portal, so an official SDK is a fair question for this kind of service. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official SDK or client library. The docs cover filing procedures and database search, and the probe shows only that data.inpi.fr requires an account-issued token. That is raw API access control at best, not an SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
